fusions.name: Hook and Haul
fusions.desc: Casts a hooked line that deals 12 damage, hauls you up to 6 tiles to the target and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mail Flail
fusions.desc: Whirls a length of mail around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Drawing Links
fusions.desc: Lays a line of links 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound and Braced
fusions.desc: Your armour is 10% higher against enemies carrying your afflictions.
